reviews.text: Absolutely the best!! He's successfully treated one of my bunnies more than once where others had failed. He's a competent vet with a deep knowledge of animals (and I'm a well-informed person and extremely demanding when it comes to my little ones), kind and helpful, one of those rare doctors who still does this job out of love for animals and not just for profit. I wouldn't trust the health of my little ones to anyone else!! Thank you so much, doctor!! 🙏🏼🐰🐰

Terrible experience....doctor who doesn't know how to do his job in January 2025 I took my bunny to have her teeth filed...THE DOCTOR IF YOU CAN CALL HIM THAT....he did a complete x-ray including the chest and didn't notice that my bunny had the beginnings of a THYMOMA (TUMOR) reassuring us that she was fine and her teeth had been filed and she had no other problems.....after 4 months I took bunny for a check-up again because I saw that she was breathing a little labored....and her eyes were more protruding than usual.....AFTER MY WIFE HAD REPEATED TO HIM SEVERAL TIMES THAT THIS PROBLEM HAD NEVER HAPPENED TO HER....THE SHOEMAKER replied that the eyes and the third eyelid were normal...due to the fright or were the teeth that needed to be filed again.....MORAL OF THE STORY TODAY MAY 27, 2025 I took Bunny to another vet, they did another x-ray and they compared the x-ray with the shoemaker's one with the new vet's and they said that Bunny had a THYMOMA since the shoemaker, DOCTOR MELLUSO, took it.... SAYING THAT FROM A SIMPLE X-RAY THE THYMOMA COULD NOT BE SEEN, BUT IT IS NOT TRUE.... in the end, Bunny is no longer there today, it's all his fault and that he didn't see the x-rays well, otherwise Bunny would still be in our arms by now.... A VERY STRONG ADVICE DO NOT BRING ANY ANIMAL TO THIS PERSON.... HE IS ONLY GOOD AT CHATTERING AND NOTHING ELSE AT ALL COSTS. HE WAS THINKING ABOUT FILING HIS TEETH AND GETTING THE 270 EUROS INSTEAD OF CURE THE BREATHING PROBLEM HE HAD.... SHAME ON YOU MELLUSO CHANGE YOUR JOB...YOU WILL CARRY BUNNY ON YOUR CONSCIENCE FOR YOUR WHOLE LIFE.....
